recent_articles.title: Mumbai, Maharashtra emerging as key hubs for global investment and clean energy partnerships, say diplomats - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Consul Generals** from **Australia** and **Finland** highlighted the growing investment opportunities in Mumbai and Maharashtra, emphasizing infrastructure development, clean energy, education, and technology sectors.  They praised Mumbai's transformation, citing projects like the Coastal Road and metro expansion as drivers of investor confidence. Both diplomats acknowledged challenges faced by foreign investors, including regulatory clarity and streamlined approval systems. Despite these challenges, they expressed optimism about Mumbai's long-term trajectory as a global economic hub.

recent_articles.title: Deepa Jewellers, Cotec Healthcare receive Sebi approval for IPOs - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Deepa Jewellers**, a Hyderabad-based company specializing in hallmarked gold jewelry processing and trading, plans to raise funds through an IPO consisting of a fresh issue and offer-for-sale. The IPO will include up to Rs 250 crore worth of shares from the company and up to 1.18 crore shares offered for sale by promoters **Ashish Agarwal** and **Seema Agarwal**.  **Cotec Healthcare**, a contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) serving pharmaceutical companies, also received Sebi approval for its IPO. The company manufactures formulations across various therapeutic segments and operates a manufacturing facility in Roorkee with an installed capacity of over 4 billion units.

recent_articles.title: Four from Telangana State colleges to go on Sakura Science Programme - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Four students** from Telangana have been selected to participate in the **Japan Science and Technology Agency’s (JST)** SAKURA Science Programme. The seven-day program, starting May 24th, will allow the students to visit advanced scientific institutions, interact with scientists, and gain exposure to Japan's innovation in education and science. The students were selected through district-level nominations and a state-level screening test conducted earlier this year.

recent_articles.title: Antarvahini Saraswati ‘Antya Pushkaralu’ begins in Kaleshwaram - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Governor Shiv Pratap Shukla** and his wife **Janaki Shukla** participated in religious ceremonies at the Saraswati Ghat during the start of the 12-day ‘Antya Pushkaralu’ festival.  Devotees from across the region gathered to witness the event, which marks the beginning of the sacred celebrations. **Sri Shankara Vijayendra Saraswathi Swami** of Kanchi Kamakoti Peetam performed special pujas and rituals at the Triveni Sangamam, where the subterranean Antarvahini Saraswati river joins the Godavari and Pranahita rivers.  **D. Sridhar Babu**, Minister for IT and Industries, and **Konda Surekha**, Endowments Minister, were also present.

recent_articles.title: Major fire at hosiery shop in Hyderabad’s Pathergatti - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A major fire broke out at the **Younus Hosiery Shop** in the SYJ Complex, Pathergatti, Hyderabad on Thursday (May 21, 2026), prompting an extensive emergency response from the **Telangana Fire Services Department**.  The fire originated in the hosiery shop and spread rapidly within the commercial complex, causing panic among shop owners and nearby establishments.  Firefighters managed to contain the blaze after several hours of firefighting operations, preventing further damage. The cause of the fire is currently under investigation.

recent_articles.title: GHMC officials’ negligence will turn Hyderabad into concrete jungle: Justice Shravan Kumar - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Telangana High Court** ordered the removal of illegal encroachments on public roads at Block no. 16, HIG-II in Hyderabad after finding that **GHMC authorities** had been derelict in their duty. The court instructed **HYDRAA**, a government organization responsible for urban development, to take immediate action to restore the area according to approved plans and ordered the government to hold erring officers accountable for their inaction.

recent_articles.title: TGBCESDTC to conduct 4-day AI and life skills training programme - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Telangana BC Employability Skill Development and Training Centre (TGBCESDTC)**, in collaboration with the **Magic Bus India Foundation**, will host a four-day interactive workshop from May 21 to June 11 across various districts of Telangana. The program aims to introduce district-level youth to artificial intelligence technologies and enhance their employability skills.  Interested youth are advised to contact their nearest TGBCESDTC centers for enrollment and further information.

recent_articles.title: Mango Diversity Show at Sangareddy FRC inaugurated - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **V. Nagi Reddy**, former Commissioner of **Telangana State Election Commission**, inaugurated the diamond jubilee celebrations and a two-day 'Mango Diversity Show' at the **Fruit Research Station (FRS)** in Sangareddy. The event, organized by the **Sri Konda Laxman Telangana State Horticultural University (SKLTGHU)**, featured over 300 mango varieties and demonstrations of agricultural advancements for farmers.  The concluding day will include a 'Mango Processed Products Competition'.

recent_articles.title: Remove Bandi Sanjay from Union Cabinet, Kavitha tells Modi - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kalvakuntla Kavitha**, president of the **Telangana Rakshana Sena**, urged **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** to remove **Union Minister of State for Home Affairs Bandi Sanjay Kumar** from his position until the investigation and trial in the POCSO case involving his son are complete.  Kavitha expressed concern over potential conflict of interest and a perception of political influence on the investigation, arguing that public trust in the justice system could be damaged by Mr. Kumar's continued presence in office.

recent_articles.title: Push for public transport exposes structural gaps - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi's** push for public transport, particularly metro rail, has prompted politicians and bureaucrats to use such systems. However, the renewed spotlight on public transit highlights a gap between policy intent and on-ground delivery.  Years of underinvestment in mass rapid transit systems have led to stalled projects like the Hyderabad Metro’s second phase and the Multi-Modal Transport System (MMTS) network. While efforts are underway to improve connectivity and funding, challenges remain, including securing approvals for expansion and procuring new train sets. The State government is also exploring a Rapid Rail Transit System (RRTS), but its suitability for urban settings remains questioned.

recent_articles.title: SIR in Telangana: Draft electoral rolls to have names of electors whose Enumeration Forms are received - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Electoral Registration Officers (ERO)** in **Telangana** will publish draft electoral rolls on July 31, 2026, including names of all electors whose Enumeration Forms were received.  Following this, EROs will issue notices to individuals who cannot be linked or have discrepancies in their linking with the previous revision's electoral rolls. This is part of a Special Intensive Revision (SIR) conducted for the first time since 2002 when **Telangana** was part of united Andhra Pradesh.

recent_articles.title: Cyberabad police begin search for Bandi Bageerath in Hyderabad and Karimnagar after HC rejects pre-arrest bail plea - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Cyberabad police** intensified their search for **Bandi Bageerath**, accused of sexually assaulting and emotionally manipulating a 17-year-old girl, by conducting searches at his residences in Hyderabad and Karimnagar.  Five police teams were involved in the operation, which included physical checks and surveillance efforts to track his whereabouts. The investigation is ongoing, with discussions about Bageerath surrendering to authorities before being subjected to medical examination and remanded.

recent_articles.title: Fuel price hike negatively impacts economy, triggers rise in essential commodity prices: Telangana CM Revanth Reddy - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **A Revanth Reddy**, **Telangana Chief Minister**, criticized the **Union Government’s** decision to increase petrol and diesel prices, arguing it would negatively impact the economy and ordinary citizens. He accused the government of mismanaging the economy through “inefficient governance” and “ill-conceived policies,” claiming that the fuel price hike was a breach of public trust and a misleading tactic for electoral gains.  He demanded the immediate withdrawal of the increase.

recent_articles.title: HC denies pre-arrest bail to Bandi Sanjay’s son, reserves order - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Telangana High Court** declined to grant pre-arrest bail to Union Minister of State for Home Affairs Bandi Sanjay's son, Sai Bageerath, in a POCSO Act case.  Justice T. Madhavi Devi reserved orders on the anticipatory bail petition and will pronounce them on May 21st. The judge heard arguments from both sides, with senior counsel S. Niranjan Reddy arguing that the relationship between the accused and the victim was amicable and the alleged offense might not be as severe as suggested in the FIR. Advocate Pappu Nageshwar Rao representing the victim's mother opposed the bail plea citing Supreme Court judgments rejecting anticipatory bails in POCSO cases and highlighting the trauma experienced by the victim. The Public Prosecutor for Home Palle Nageshwar Rao refuted the arguments of the petitioner’s counsel regarding an improvement in the FIR.

recent_articles.title: Telangana Congress raises concerns over SIR process - The Hindu
recent_articles.sentiment_target: Telangana Chief Electoral Officer C. Sudarshan Reddy
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Telangana Pradesh Congress Committee (TPCC)** met **Telangana Chief Electoral Officer C. Sudarshan Reddy** on May 15, 2026, to express concerns and suggest improvements for the proposed Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of electoral rolls. The party urged a phased and carefully planned revision process over one-and-a-half to two years, citing concerns about the scale of the exercise and the lack of major elections scheduled in the near future.  They also requested specific measures like providing voter lists from 2002 and 2025, extending objection periods, ensuring physical notice before deletion, conducting proper field verification, and addressing allegations of irregularities in the pre-SIR mapping process. The Congress party also demanded safeguards for migrant voters and special awareness programs for weaker sections.

recent_articles.title: Singareni’s past glory will be restored through new mines, new jobs: Minister Vivek Venkataswamy - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Dr. G. Vivek Venkataswamy**, **Minister for Labour, Mines & Geology**, emphasized the state government's commitment to restoring the glory of **Singareni Collieries Company Limited (SCCL)** through new coal mines and employment opportunities. He highlighted the Ramakrishnapur Opencast (RKP OC) Phase-2 project's potential to create 5,000 jobs and urged collaboration between workers and officials for SCCL's growth.  **A. Revanth Reddy**, **Chief Minister**, is aware of the issue regarding employee perks, while **Gaddam Vamsi Krishna**, **Peddapalli MP**, is advocating for a ₹10,000 monthly pension for retired SCCL workers in Parliament.

recent_articles.title: Cancellation sparks anger, anxiety among aspirants in Telangana - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **NEET (UG)** 2026 has been canceled following allegations of a paper leak, causing widespread frustration and anxiety among students, parents, and educators in **Telangana**.  Long-term aspirants like Mounika U. expressed disappointment over the system failure, while **G. Vijay Kumar**, a NEET trainer, highlighted the emotional impact on young students. The **Students’ Federation of India (Telangana)** criticized the government's handling of the situation, calling it an "administrative failure." Protests are planned by student groups and organizations demanding fair and transparent examination processes.

recent_articles.title: Chief Minister Revanth Reddy meets Governor - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister A Revanth Reddy** invited **Governor Shiv Pratap Shukla** to a program on June 12th, celebrating the reopening of schools. The program will feature the administration of a mass pledge against tobacco, alcohol, and drugs, along with the distribution of educational kits containing uniforms, textbooks, notebooks, school bags, sportswear, and other study materials.

recent_articles.title: Achieve 90% progress in mapping by end of May; ECI’s SIR announcement shortly: Telangana CEO - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Election Commission of India (ECI)** directed **District Collectors** to achieve 90% progress in mapping electors by the end of the month for a Special Intensive Revision (SIR).  **Chief Electoral Officer (CEO) Telangana, C Sudharshan Reddy**, instructed **Electoral Registration Officers (ERO), AEROs, Booth Level Officers (BLOs)** to visit slums and gated communities for this purpose. The CEO also asked for involvement of representatives from these communities, ration shop dealers, self-help groups, and employee unions to accelerate the mapping process.

recent_articles.title: ECI set to roll out phase III of SIR in ‘coming days’ to cover 22 States, UTs - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Election Commission of India (ECI)** is set to begin phase three of its Special Intensive Revision (SIR) voter list process in the coming days, covering nearly 40 crore electors across 17 states and five UTs.  This follows completion of SIR in 10 states and three UTs previously, which has successfully removed over 60 lakh deceased voters from the rolls. The ECI had initially delayed the rollout due to Assembly elections in several states but is now proceeding with the revision process.  The exercise aims to ensure accurate voter lists for upcoming elections.

recent_articles.title: Did BJP internal wranglings upset Modi? - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi's** visit to Telangana was met with disappointment among **BJP** leaders, who expressed dissatisfaction over internal disagreements and factional politics.  Sources claim the PM was particularly upset by his time spent with Andhra Pradesh CM **Chandrababu Naidu** and Deputy CM **Pawan Kalyan**, which they believe unnerved party members.

recent_articles.title: Former GHMC mayor to head TG Women’s Commission - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Gadwal Vijaylaxmi**, former **GHMC mayor**, has been appointed chairperson of the **Telangana Women’s Commission**.  She will serve a five-year term, alongside six other members: **Kasoju Sankaramma**, **Chityala Swetha**, **Shashikala Yadava Reddy**, **Sada Laxmi**, **N. Radha Bai**, and **Ujma Ashai Shakira**. The appointments were made by **Chief Secretary K. Ramakrishna Rao** on Monday.

recent_articles.title: The road to deliver women’s safety - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The case of **Sai Bhagirath**, son of Union Minister of State for Home Affairs **Bandi Sanjay**, under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act is being closely watched as a test of how **Telangana** handles crimes against women and children. The state government has taken several steps to address online and offline harassment, including launching the "Stand with Her" initiative and investigating cases of cyberbullying. However, the case highlights the challenge of balancing free expression with curbing online targeting and harassment, particularly for women in positions of power.  The incident has sparked protests demanding action from both women's groups and political parties.

recent_articles.title: Education Budget will grow every year, says Telangana CM Revanth Reddy - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy** announced that the **Telangana government** will prioritize education, aiming for a 15% allocation in future budgets, gradually increasing from the current 7.6%.  He highlighted the implementation of several initiatives since December 2023, including teacher recruitment, DSC notifications, and global exchange programs. The "Exclusive Education Week" celebrations aim to showcase progress and improve learning facilities across the state. **Mr. Reddy** emphasized that education is an investment in the future and stressed the importance of teachers in building a better society.

recent_articles.title: Telangana BIE re-releases admission schedule; classes for Inter first year to begin from June 1 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Board of Intermediate Education (BIE)** released the admissions schedule for 2026-27, with phase-I admissions starting on Tuesday and concluding by June 30.  **Principals** are instructed to make provisional admissions based on internet marks memo downloaded by candidates, which will be confirmed upon presentation of original SSC pass certificates and transfer certificates. **The BIE** also mandated Aadhaar details for students and directed colleges to limit sections to a maximum of 88 students with prior approval for additional sections.

recent_articles.title: Summit highlights urgency of aligning education with future job markets - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Apollo University**, **Chittoor** and the **University of Leicester** jointly hosted the second edition of the Apollo-Leicester Education Summit-2026 in Vijayawada. The summit brought together diplomats, academic leaders, and industry experts from both countries to discuss how students can prepare for careers in 2030 and beyond.  **Daniel Ladley**, Pro Vice-Chancellor of the **University of Leicester School of Business**, emphasized the importance of globally relevant, employability-focused education. **Gareth Wynn Owen**, British Deputy High Commissioner for Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, highlighted the growing collaboration between India and the UK in education, innovation, and careers.

recent_articles.title: Telangana BJP distances itself from POCSO case against Bandi Sanjay’s son, calls it legal issue - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Bharatiya Janata Party** (BJP) in Telangana distanced itself from a POCSO case involving the son of Union Minister of State for Home Affairs, Bandi Sanjay Kumar. The state BJP president, N. Ramchander Rao, stated that the party has no connection to the matter and will investigate if any family member is involved.  Rao also addressed allegations of discrepancies in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) conducted during the recent Assembly elections, claiming it was a clean-up exercise approved by the Election Commission and Supreme Court. He asserted that the SIR aimed to eliminate "bogus" voters and that the results reflected the mandate of genuine voters.

recent_articles.title: Bandi Bhagirath’s case takes serious turn with Telangana CM ordering special team for comprehensive probe - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **A. Revanth Reddy**, **Telangana Chief Minister**, has demanded an immediate investigation into allegations of sexual harassment against the son of **Union Minister of State for Home Affairs Bandi Sanjay Kumar**, **Bandi Bhagirath**.  The Chief Minister, who is also the Home Minister, instructed the Director General of Police (DGP), **C.V. Anand**, to launch a probe into the case registered at Pet Basheerabad Police Station. The investigation follows allegations that the police have been slow to act on the complaint lodged by the alleged victim on May 8th.

recent_articles.title: ‘Compromised PM’ no longer capable of running country: Rahul slams Modi - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rahul Gandhi**, leader of the **Congress**, criticized **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** for urging citizens to make sacrifices during the West Asia conflict, calling it evidence of failure.  Gandhi argued that these measures are shifting responsibility onto the public and highlight the government's inability to address the crisis. The **Congress** also condemned **Modi**'s call for reducing fuel consumption and postponing gold purchases, claiming it is reckless and immoral.  The Prime Minister, meanwhile, urged citizens to use petroleum products judiciously, postpone gold purchases, and adopt alternative modes of transport to strengthen the economy amidst the global crisis.

recent_articles.title: PIL in SC for reviewing wages of priests, sevadars and temple staff in govt.-controlled temples - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: An advocate, **Ashwini Upadhyay**, has filed a plea in the Supreme Court seeking direction for the Centre and State governments to establish a judicial commission or expert committee to review wages and benefits provided to priests, sevadars, and temple staff in state-controlled temples. The petition argues that these individuals are employees under the Code on Wages, 2019, and that denying them dignified wages violates their right to livelihood guaranteed by Article 21 of the Constitution.  **Upadhyay** cites instances of protests in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana demanding minimum wages for priests and temple staff who are not receiving even the minimum wage prescribed by the State. The plea also highlights a circular issued by a Tamil Nadu department prohibiting priests from accepting 'Dakshina' in 'aarti plates', further highlighting the precarious nature of their livelihood.

recent_articles.title: Modi urges Indians to reduce petrol, diesel consumption amid Middle East war disruption - World - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Narendra Modi**, the Indian Prime Minister, urged citizens to reduce petrol and diesel consumption due to global supply disruptions caused by the Middle East war.  He emphasized using public transportation like metro lines and carpooling when necessary to conserve fuel and foreign currency. **Modi** also encouraged a return to energy-saving measures from the Covid-19 pandemic era, such as working from home and utilizing virtual meetings.

recent_articles.title: A.P. EAPCET-2026 to begin from May 12 across A.P. and Telangana - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Andhra Pradesh State Council of Higher Education (APSCHE)** has completed preparations for the A.P. EAPCET-2026, a common entrance test for engineering, agriculture, and pharmacy programs, scheduled for May 12-20 in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.  **B. Tirupati Rao**, Council Secretary, announced that over 355,000 candidates applied online this year. The exam will be computer-based with two sessions: 9 a.m. to 12 p.m. and 2 p.m. to 5 p.m., overseen by **Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University (JNTU)-Kakinada** and chaired by **N. Mohan Rao**.

recent_articles.title: Ramchander Rao says public response to Modi rally points to party’s rise in Telangana - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **N. Ramchander Rao**, the **BJP** State president, claimed a massive turnout at the party's public meeting in Secunderabad indicated growing support for the BJP in Telangana.  He attributed the large crowd to Prime Minister **Narendra Modi's** popularity and asserted that it signaled the BJP would form the next government in the state.

recent_articles.title: Indian-origin man, sole earner of family, dies of heart attack in Florida: ‘Worked tirelessly for a better life in US’ - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A Telugu-origin IT professional, **Sunil Kumar Gundrai**, died of a heart attack in Florida last week while working for **Capgemini** in Tampa.  His sudden death has left his wife and two young children facing emotional and financial hardship. A community fundraising effort has been launched to support the family with immediate needs like living expenses and funeral costs, as well as long-term educational support for their children. The fundraiser has already collected over $64,553 of its $200,000 goal.

recent_articles.title: Telangana BJP chief’s special memento for Modi - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **N. Ramachandra Rao**, the State BJP president, presented **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** with eight bronze Asthalaxmis at a public meeting in Hyderabad on Sunday.  Earlier, **Union Minister G.Kishan Reddy** honored **Modi** with a shawl and a statue of Lord Ram from Ayodhya during a separate event at the HICC.

recent_articles.title: PM Modi assures more support to Telangana, asks CM Revanth to collaborate with him - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** assured **Telangana Chief Minister A. Revanth Reddy** that the **Central government** would continue to support its development, emphasizing the importance of state-level progress for a developed India by 2047.  During his visit on May 10, 2026, **Modi** inaugurated several developmental projects worth ₹9,400 crore, including industrial parks and railway infrastructure, aiming to make Telangana a manufacturing hub. He highlighted the government's commitment to creating employment opportunities and reviving the textile industry through schemes like PM Mitra Park at Warangal and investments in infrastructure development.  The Prime Minister also emphasized the importance of energy security with the launch of the Malkapur terminal.

recent_articles.title: Modi to set the tone for capturing Telangana after Bengal - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** is scheduled to visit Telangana on Sunday, marking a significant push by the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** to establish itself as a major electoral force in the state.  Party leaders believe the Prime Minister's address will signal the BJP's intention to capture power in the next Assembly elections and are confident that his popularity will help expand their base.  **N. Ramchander Rao**, **Union Ministers G. Kishan Reddy** and **Bandi Sanjay Kumar** and party workers are anticipating a strong response from the public.

recent_articles.title: EAPCET 2026 engineering test records 93% attendance - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Telangana Council of Higher Education** Chairman V. Balakista Reddy, **JNTUH Vice-Chancellor T. Kishen Kumar Reddy**, and **TG EAPCET Convener K. Vijaya Kumar Reddy** witnessed high attendance rates for the engineering stream of the 2026 EAPCET, with 93.44% and 93.05% participation in the first and second sessions respectively. The highest attendance was recorded in districts like Nalgonda, Nizamabad, Karimnagar, and Bhadradri Kothagudem, with over 32,000 candidates attending each session out of a total of 34,823 allotted for the morning session.

recent_articles.title: PM Modi to dedicate Telangana railway projects worth Rs. 1,535 crore on May 10 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** will dedicate key railway infrastructure projects in Telangana on Sunday, May 10, 2026. The projects include sections of the Kazipet–Vijayawada multi-tracking project and the Kazipet Rail Under Bypass. These initiatives are expected to enhance rail capacity, improve punctuality, and support economic activity across the region.  The **Centre**'s push to modernise railway infrastructure is also reflected in these projects.
